body: ArenaHero gained hero_id; ability functions now dispatch on it instead of S170-18's hardcoded owner==0. Wired The Duck's Q/R (W/E flagged and skipped, not faked -- no objectives in arena, E's trigger coincides with match-end). arena_init() defaults player=Unicorn, bot=Duck with heuristic bot-casting, giving the bot side a real kit for the first time. 6 new headless tests, all green alongside full existing suite. 10 heroes remain as follow-on passes. Commit 63b94e7. BACKLOG S170-31.
